description: Renovation of the Sayurupura, Sahaspura and Sinhapura Stage I and Sinhapura Phase II Housing Schemes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that essential maintenance works should be carried out expeditiously to enhance the living standards of the beneficiaries, ensure safety and increase the durability of the buildings in the housing schemes of Angulana Sayurupura, Borella Sahaspura and Sinhapura Phase I and Sinhapura Phase II, implemented by the Urban Settlement Development Authority for the community living in low facility urban settlements. It has been estimated that an amount of Rs. 764.09 million will be incurred for this. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to take necessary steps to complete the said renovations during the years 2026 and 2027 using funds from the Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.
